instruction: Select the + between the last Initialize variable and Get current weather (right-click it if a menu doesn't open), then choose Add a parallel branch.
title: Animation: open the + between two actions and choose Add a parallel branch
intro: Press Play to watch step 1: the +, then Add a parallel branch.

steps.caption: Select the + between Initialize variable 3 and Get current weather. If a menu doesn't open, right-click it.
The Add an action panel opens for the new branch. The branch appears beside Get current weather once you pick its first action, Current time, in step 2.
